ways.label: Travers-Sabine Circuit from St Arnaud (Kerr Bay) via Speargrass Hut

start.name: Eastern end of Kerr Bay, St Arnaud
start.quote: From Kerr Bay: Beginning at the eastern end of the bay

evidence: The circuit is best walked as described below because crossing the Poukirikiri/Travers Saddle is easier from the Travers side.
From Kerr Bay: Beginning at the eastern end of the bay, the Lakehead Track wanders through forest, crossing several shallow streams and shingle screes.
From Sabine Hut there are two ways to finish the tramp: either by tramping via Speargrass Hut and the Speargrass Valley, or taking the Rotoroa Water Taxi to Rotoroa village.
From here, it is 1 hr 30 min down Mount Robert Road to St Arnaud village.

doubts: The loop's start is given as Kerr Bay (F6, where Kerr Bay Track meets Kerr Bay Road; the text says the Lakehead Track begins at the eastern end of the bay) and the text ends the circuit at 'St Arnaud village' after walking down Mount Robert Road; it does not say the walk returns to Kerr Bay itself, so the end is set to the same place to close the loop. Mount Robert car park ref F1 (Speargrass Track meets Mt Robert Road) is my best match for the car park reached from Speargrass Hut, but the text does not name the Speargrass Track; F2/F3 are nearby alternatives. Coldwater Hut is the first-night alternative to Lakehead Hut ('Lakehead Hut/Coldwater Hut') reached from the West Bay start, not on the Kerr Bay route itself. W2 (finish at Sabine Hut by water taxi) is offered by the page as the other way to finish; its walking part ends at Sabine Hut. The water taxi start at the head of Lake Rotoiti has no matching feature. Direction is not stated as clockwise/anticlockwise, only 'as described'.
